name: Aegis pest Detection Rover
summary: An autonomous rover that patrols a farm plot and uses computer vision to detect soil and crop pests. Each time a pest is identified, it sends an instant alert to the owner's phone via Telegram, enabling timely, targeted intervention and reducing crop losses.
